values.note: 180 modern sites in a north loop (99) and a south loop (81), each on its own asphalt or concrete pad. Allowed trailer/RV length is 45 ft at 48 sites, 40 ft at 61, 35 ft at 49, 30 ft at 19, 25 ft at 3; 11 pull-throughs. Also six walk-in rustic sites and a 20-site auxiliary overflow area.

note: Modern campground in two loops, each site on its own asphalt or concrete pad screened by shrubs. The park surrounds 410-acre Lake Ovid, but the campground is set back inland with a footpath/short drive to the swim beach; one fishing pier is near the campground. 12+ miles of equestrian trails with a staging area just past the campground entrance. --Claude
